source.title: ITU Congo national numbering plan communication of 1.XI.2024

phones.notes: ITU/ARPCE confirms country code +242, nine-digit national significant numbers and recent mobile Voice/SMS/Data assignments in the 06 range. Public numbering references list 01, 04, 05 and 06 as mobile prefixes; generated numbers are synthetic and not checked for current subscriber assignment or portability.

The location block source gives country-level address context; each address record carries its own map source.

national_identity_card_number.label: National Identity Card

source.title: IRB Canada: Republic of the Congo national identity card

national_identity_card_number.notes: The public response describes the CNI followed by a personal identification number on the card, but does not confirm a current public number length, checksum or semantic digit rule. Runtime no longer prefixes the generated value with CNI because no source confirms that the document label is part of the number.

passport.notes: PRADO confirms ordinary passport entries for the Republic of the Congo. The public listing does not confirm passport-number grammar, so generation remains template-only synthetic.
